title: Are plant-based substitutes healthier than meat?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What should 'healthier than meat' actually mean: fewer calories, less fat, more nutrients, or something else?
Would you choose a plant-based substitute if it tasted good but was highly processed?
Should plant-based products be allowed to use words such as 'burger' or 'sausage'?
How much should environmental impact influence our judgement of whether a food is a good substitute?
What would make you replace meat more often in your own diet?
